general.title: OMIX Gene Boxplots
general.instructions:
Create sample-level gene-expression plots for selected genes.

For a DEG workflow result, connect or attach the folder containing `DEG_Analysis.csv` and separately attach `Sample_Metadata.csv`. Leave file upload fields blank and the capsule discovers exactly one of each file below `/data`. Alternatively upload the tables directly.

Use **Precomputed DEG statistics** (recommended) to annotate the plot with the original limma/voom statistics. Use **Within-plot tests** only for an exploratory independent comparison of the plotted values.

categories.name: 📁 Input data
categories.help_text: Supply an expression/DEG result and matching sample metadata. File uploads override files discovered from connected data assets or workflow results.

categories.name: 📊 Statistics
categories.help_text: Choose whether annotations use the original DEG model, a new exploratory test, or no statistics.

categories.name: 🎨 Appearance
categories.help_text: Control plot type, labels, colors, and image resolution.

parameters.name: Expression Table (Optional)
parameters.help_text: Upload normalized, voom-scale, or batch-corrected expression values. If blank, `DEG_Analysis.csv` is discovered from the connected result or data asset.

parameters.name: Sample Metadata (Optional)
parameters.help_text: Upload a metadata table containing Sample and Group columns. If blank, exactly one `Sample_Metadata.csv` is discovered under /data.

parameters.name: DEG Results (Optional)
parameters.help_text: Optional separate DEG table with columns such as B-A_pval or B-A_adjpval. Leave blank when the expression table is `DEG_Analysis.csv`.

parameters.name: Genes to Plot
parameters.help_text: Required comma-separated identifiers exactly as they appear in the Gene ID Column (for example: Nfil3,Tox,Zbtb16).

parameters.name: Gene ID Column
parameters.help_text: Identifier column in the expression table.

parameters.name: DEG Gene ID Column
parameters.help_text: Identifier column in a separate DEG result table. Keep GeneName when using an OMIX DEG result.

parameters.name: Sample ID Column
parameters.help_text: Metadata column whose values exactly match the expression sample-column names.

parameters.name: Group Column
parameters.help_text: Metadata column used for the x-axis groups.

parameters.name: Groups to Include (Optional)
parameters.help_text: Optional comma-separated values from Group Column. Leave blank to include every group.

parameters.name: Statistics Source
parameters.help_text: Precomputed DEG statistics preserves the original DEG model and is recommended. Within-plot tests run a new simple test on only the displayed values.

parameters.name: P-value Type
parameters.help_text: Select nominal for *_pval or adjusted for *_adjpval when plotting precomputed DEG statistics.

parameters.name: Within-plot Test
parameters.help_text: Used only when Statistics Source is within_plot.

parameters.name: Within-plot P-value Adjustment
parameters.help_text: Method used to adjust multiple exploratory within-plot comparisons.

parameters.name: Minimum Samples per Group
parameters.help_text: Groups with fewer samples are excluded. At least two groups must remain.

parameters.name: Y-axis Label
parameters.help_text: Describe the scale supplied in the expression table, such as Batch-corrected expression or log2 CPM.

parameters.name: Group Colors (Optional)
parameters.help_text: Optional comma-separated color names or HEX values, assigned in group order.
